correction: Data.ThreadClosed applies a close's reply over any copy of the thread that is not closed, whatever its updatedAt: a thread never leaves closed, and pocketd's clock may give the close the same updatedAt as the copy held or an earlier one. Only over a closed copy does it need a later updatedAt.
